# Find if Path Exists in Graph.

@example Cross from island 3 to island 1, then from 1 to 4.
5
[[3,1],[1,4],[0,2]]
3
4
=> true

@example Islands 0 and 1 are linked only to each other, and so are 2 and 3.
4
[[0,1],[2,3]]
1
2
=> false

@example Island 2 has no footbridge, but you are standing on it already.
3
[[0,1]]
2
2
=> true
